use_when: Zendesk HTML/editor source for public customer-facing Resolution content.
snippet:
1. Connect to the server via SSH.
  2. Run the required command:

    # command

  3. Log in to Plesk.
  4. Go to Plesk > Tools & Settings.
guidance: wrap only the customer-facing resolution body
keep steps as plain numbered list items
link Log in to Plesk to the canonical Plesk login how-to article
link reusable public how-to procedures in the exact step instead of re-explaining them
link Plesk Firewall rule management to https://support.plesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/12377519983511-How-to-manage-local-firewall-rules-using-Plesk-Firewall-in-Plesk-for-Linux

use

# command

for Linux commands instead of
do not use h3/h4 headings for steps
do not use this wrapper for plain Markdown drafts

use_when: Zendesk HTML/editor source for technical/SCR Symptoms sections.
snippet:
Symptoms

  1. Plesk Panel returns 502 Bad Gateway.
  2. The server has high CPU load.
guidance: use a numbered list for Symptoms, matching Resolution readability
put visible errors, commands, or output snippets inside the relevant symptom item
do not use standalone paragraphs or unordered bullets for technical Symptoms

use_when: Zendesk HTML/editor source when GUI and CLI are equivalent alternatives for the same safe action.
snippet:
Plesk GUI CLI
GUI steps go here.
CLI steps go here.
guidance: put the GUI tab first when GUI is available
use tabs for equivalent alternatives, not required sequential steps
avoid_when: one path is required before the other

use_when: Zendesk HTML/editor source for optional, advanced, manual, or fallback details that should not interrupt the main path.
snippet:
Advanced path
Optional advanced steps go here.
guidance: use only for optional or fallback content
main resolution must remain understandable without opening the accordion
avoid_when: short content that is clearer inline

use_when: Zendesk HTML/editor source for developer-only, risky, unsupported, or too complex details that must not be customer-facing.
guidance: never put customer-required steps only in internaldata
use for reviewer/developer context or blocked risky workarounds

use_when: Zendesk trigger text for standalone Linux shell commands.
guidance: keep commands separate from output
do not include a shell prompt unless it is evidence
use safe placeholders

use_when: Zendesk trigger text for standalone Windows command prompt commands.
guidance: use only for Windows command prompt input
keep command output in a separate output/config block
avoid_when: PowerShell-specific syntax unless the article standard approves it

use_when: Zendesk trigger text for configuration text, logs, and command output when a more specific Plesk presentation trigger is not required.
guidance: use for generic logs, output, and config snippets
use PLESK_ERROR for pink-background Plesk errors, PLESK_WARN for yellow-background warnings, and PLESK_INFO for white/gray Plesk errors and messages
do not infer the Plesk presentation trigger from error vocabulary alone
do not mark output as bash commands

use_when: Zendesk trigger text for important warnings and supporting notes.
snippet: Warning: Important precaution goes here.\n\nNote: Supporting note goes here.
guidance: use warnings before risky or service-impacting actions
use notes for supporting information that is not a warning

use_when: Zendesk trigger text for standalone Windows PowerShell commands.
guidance: use for PowerShell commands
keep command output in CONFIG_TEXT or another output block

use_when: Zendesk HTML/editor source for article images that need lightbox enlargement.
guidance: use class="resizable" for screenshots that readers may need to enlarge
verify public media after publication without being signed in

use_when: Zendesk HTML/editor source for KCS style-guide tabs.
snippet:
Plesk GUI
GUI path.
CLI
CLI path.
guidance: use tabs for equivalent alternatives
keep tab headers short
define exactly one default tab

use_when: Zendesk HTML/editor source for optional collapsed details.
guidance: use after tabs when collapsed optional detail is clearer
do not hide required customer steps

use_when: Zendesk HTML/editor source for complex tables.
guidance: use the approved table100 wrapper for complex Zendesk tables
keep table content concise
avoid_when: two-column text that is clearer as bullets
